typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 998244353;
const int IBIG = 1000000007;
const int IMAX = 2147483647;

const ll LMAX = 9223372036854775807LL;

int fact[200005];
int ifact[200005];

int fpow(int a, int b) {
    if (a == 0) return 0;
    int ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = (ll)ans * a % MOD;
        a = (ll)a * a % MOD;

int fmul(int a, int b) {

int ifact_func(int x) {
    if (ifact[x] > 0) return ifact[x];
    return ifact[x] = fpow(fact[x], MOD - 2);

    total = fmul(total, ifact_func(n - k));
    if (k != 0) {

    }
    cout << total << '\n';
    return 0;
